note: Invented sample recipes for the demo. Grams are one serving.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetables
recipes.method:
1. Heat the oven to 200 C.
2. Toss the vegetables with oil, salt and pepper.
3. Roast for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Garlic spinach
recipes.method:
1. Warm the oil.
2. Add garlic, then the spinach.
3. Cook for 2 minutes and season.

recipes.name: Green bean sabzi
recipes.method:
1. Soften the onion in oil.
2. Add the beans and spices.
3. Cover and cook until tender.

recipes.name: Cucumber and mint salad
recipes.method:
1. Slice the cucumber.
2. Mix with mint, lemon and salt.

recipes.name: Mint chutney
recipes.method: 1. Blend mint, coriander and lemon with a little water.

recipes.name: Tomato soup
recipes.method:
1. Simmer tomatoes with garlic.
2. Blend and season.

shakes.name: Plain protein shake
shakes.method: 1. Blend the whey with cold water.

drinks.name: Ginger tea
drinks.method: 1. Boil sliced ginger in water for 5 minutes and strain.
